milestones.question: In a controlled replay, does requesting host-KV load during a tool wait shorten time from tool return to first token compared with requesting it after the wait?
milestones.answer: In these sampled runs, yes: late preparation added 166-178 ms across four comparable pairs. Most of that difference occurred before replay submission.
milestones.unknown: How much remains with a nonblocking control call, and whether preparing early delays other sessions. These runs do not establish a production or hardware benefit.
